summary: Multi-PC (Fase 1) full-stack testing. 12/12 backend pytest passed (device CRUD, activate, X-Device registration, 402 device_limit for starter on 2nd PC, legacy agent → primary device fallback, overlay cross-PC source_device with 400 on invalid device, telemetry/missions/subscriptions regression). Frontend playwright: admin sees device-switcher-btn, menu opens with 2 PCs, switch to stream-box triggers reload and shows 'PC Streaming' as active; /app/pc DevicesPanel renders 2 device rows with role selects + rename buttons + Use-this button; /app/live shows overlay-source-section with 3 options (active + 2 PCs) and clicks persist. Starter user correctly has NO switcher and NO devices-panel. Milestones daily-block present.

issues: Cookies & privacy banner overlaps the Live Preview area at 1920x1080 viewport, hiding the bottom overlay tips text. Not blocking testids but worth improving z-index/positioning.

critical_code_review_comments: devices.py resolve_device: role auto-assignment on 3rd+ device is 'other'; consider letting user pick role in a modal instead of hardcoded fallback.
DeviceSwitcher.jsx uses window.location.reload() after activate — heavy UX; a global refetch (SWR/react-query invalidate) would be smoother, but acceptable for MVP.

overlay.py update_config source_device validation only checks device existence; when a device is later deleted the overlay_tokens.source_device is NOT cleared → next /overlay/{token}/data silently falls back to active PC (works, but stale config). Consider cleanup in DELETE /api/devices/{id}.
plan_gate.get_entitlements: device_limit is hardcoded (1/3/99) — good, but not surfaced via /subscriptions/status. Frontend has to hit /api/devices to know the limit.
seed_data_creation: Test devices PC-TEST-A / PC-TEST-DEL are created and deleted within the pytest run. No residual data. Confirmed via DB read: admin devices == [gaming-rig, stream-box], admin.active_device == 'gaming-rig', overlay_tokens.source_device == None, starter plan='starter' with only casa-pc.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-PC Fase 1 verified end-to-end. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_multi_pc.py (reusable regression). Cleanup logic inside the tests reactivates gaming-rig and removes PC-TEST-*. For future Multi-PC tests: use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env; agent token via GET /api/agent/token (cookie auth); X-Device header is slugified server-side; overlay is streamer-gated (require_streamer).
